performance.evidence: The no-VCS fallback is limited to retained source-tree packaging and creates one local gzip archive. It adds no player runtime path, network call, retry loop, or background work.

reliability.evidence: VCS checkouts retain Meson dist; fresh retained archives build packages without .git. The archive test derives the project version, package verification checks exact ELF SONAME, and Meson passed 30/30 tests.

operability.evidence: No-VCS attempts report missing configuration or missing archives clearly, avoid inherited make jobserver state, and clean temporary integration output. Release docs continue to describe the VCS Meson and extracted-only workflow path.
